go.html: package main import ( "fmt" "strings" ) type Catalog struct { zh map[string]string en map[string]string } func (c *Catalog) T(locale, key string, params map[string]any) string { messages := c.zh if locale == "en" { messages = c.en } raw, ok := messages[key] if !ok { return key } for name, value := range params { raw = strings.ReplaceAll(raw, "{"+name+"}", fmt.Sprint(value)) } return raw } func main() { c := &Catalog{zh: map[string]string{"chat.msgs": "{count} 条"}} fmt.Println(c.T("zh", "chat.msgs", map[string]any{"count": 42})) }

java.html: package com.autostack.musk; import java.util.List; import java.util.Map; public final class Catalog { private final Map<String, Object> zh; private final Map<String, Object> en; public Catalog(Map<String, Object> zh, Map<String, Object> en) { this.zh = zh; this.en = en; } public String t(String locale, String key, Map<String, Object> params) { Object leaf = lookup("zh".equals(locale) ? zh : en, key); if (!(leaf instanceof String raw)) return key; for (var e : params.entrySet()) { raw = raw.replace("{" + e.getKey() + "}", String.valueOf(e.getValue())); } return raw; } }

python.html: import json from pathlib import Path def load_catalog(locale: str) -> dict: path = Path("src/front/i18n") / f"{locale}.json" return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) def i18n_t(catalog: dict, key: str, params: dict | None = None) -> str: cur = catalog for part in key.split("."): if not isinstance(cur, dict) or part not in cur: return key cur = cur[part] if not isinstance(cur, str): return key for name, value in (params or {}).items(): cur = cur.replace("{" + name + "}", str(value)) return cur if __name__ == "__main__": zh = load_catalog("zh") print(i18n_t(zh, "chat.msgs", {"count": 42}))

rust.html: use syntect::parsing::SyntaxSet; fn i18n_lookup(messages: &MsgMap, key: &str) -> Option<&str> { let mut cur = messages; for part in key.split('.') { cur = cur.get(part)?; } cur.as_str() } pub struct Catalog { zh: MsgMap, en: MsgMap, } impl Catalog { pub fn t(&self, locale: &str, key: &str, count: i64) -> String { let map = if locale == "zh" { &self.zh } else { &self.en }; let raw = i18n_lookup(map, key).unwrap_or(key); raw.replace("{count}", &count.to_string()) } }
